mapper.select: SELECT itu.inspection_team_id FROM lm_inspection_team_user itu INNER JOIN lm_inspection_team it ON itu.inspection_team_id = it.id WHERE itu.user_id = #{userId} AND it.is_deleted = 0 AND it.status = 1

SELECT isi.id as scheme_item_id, isi.inspect_item_id, ii.name as inspect_item_name, ii.code as inspect_item_code, isp.id as scheme_parameter_id, isp.parameter_id, isp.record_item_id AS recordItemId, isp.record_id AS recordId, isp.record_version_id AS recordVersionId, isp.record_code AS recordCode, ip.name as parameter_name, ip.code as parameter_code, isp.is_executable, isp.is_reportable, isp.execute_method AS executeMethod FROM lm_inspection_scheme_item isi INNER JOIN lm_inspect_item ii ON isi.inspect_item_id = ii.id INNER JOIN lm_inspection_scheme_parameter isp ON isi.id = isp.item_config_id INNER JOIN lm_inspect_parameter ip ON isp.parameter_id = ip.id WHERE isi.version_id = #{schemeVersionId} AND isi.is_deleted = 0 AND ii.is_deleted = 0 AND isp.is_deleted = 0 AND ip.is_deleted = 0 AND isp.is_executable = 1 ORDER BY isi.sort ASC, ii.code ASC, ip.code ASC

SELECT MIN( CASE WHEN t.claim_time IS NULL THEN t.assign_time WHEN t.assign_time IS NULL THEN t.claim_time WHEN t.claim_time <= t.assign_time THEN t.claim_time ELSE t.assign_time END ) FROM lm_task t WHERE t.inspection_order_id = #{inspectionOrderId} AND t.is_deleted = 0
